TWO LOADER SUBSTITUTIONS ARE MANDATORY and are not cosmetic: the template names ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-1.1_transformer_only_BF16 and gemma-3-12b-it-heretic-fp8-comfy, NEITHER of which exists on this install. It queues only with the weights the app already ships - _int8_convrot and gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed. Without both, /api/prompt returns 400 prompt_outputs_failed_validation

THE ANSWER: face size in the guide. A 1920x1088 source squeezed to 960x544 by #5009 ResizeImageMaskNode left the head too small and nothing moved across three runs. The SAME graph, weights and seed on a head-and-shoulders crop already at 960x544 moved the lips and cloned the voice. Fabio confirmed by watching lipdub_face_00001_

WHAT THE FEATURE IS, from Lightricks README:99 - source video PLUS a prompt containing the dialogue, out comes new lip movement AND new audio. Supplied audio is a speaker-identity reference (iclora.py:534, prepended with negative temporal positions), never what the lips follow. Both this card brief and MPI-4 brief describe it wrongly; plan.md Plan Drift records the correction

FROZEN AUDIO IS A DEAD END, proven at guide 1.00 / 0.75 / 0.50: the supplied track is preserved exactly in all three and the mouth never moves. The lips follow the audio the model GENERATES, so clamping the audio leaves nothing to sync to. frozen_audio is a stage-2 device - the official two-stage graph feeds it the STAGE-1 GENERATED audio while the upscale pass redoes the video

key_decisions: PRODUCT SCOPE, set by Fabio this session: REFERENCE-AUDIO MODE IS THE FEATURE, not a fallback. Two use cases in his words - a user whose voices are inconsistent across previous videos uses this to keep consistency, and a user with a clip where the character says nothing supplies a reference voice and tells her to say something. It does NOT need to copy the input audio

DUB-BY-TRANSCRIPTION IS OUT for now. It needs Whisper for speech-to-text, a loop so users can feed long videos, and more dependencies - and dub is a long-video feature. Revisit only if users ask for it

DIRECT AUDIO IS STILL WANTED, for SINGING: a user with a singing clip wants the character to sing it WITHOUT the audio changing, and no text line can reconstruct a melody. This is the one case reference mode cannot serve. It is NOT available from the lipdub IC-LoRA, so it needs a different mechanism

THE APP FLOW SHAPE Fabio described: accept an IMAGE or a VIDEO, an optional prompt, a toggle for using the voice as reference, and audio clip input(s). He has already run TWO VOICES IN ONE AUDIO FILE to voice two characters and it worked - but on text-to-video and image-to-video, not through this lipdub graph

The shipped app graph ALREADY has the audio-driven mechanism: Input_Audio (#477) -> LTXVAudioVAEEncode (#198) -> SetLatentNoiseMask (#200) -> LTXVConcatAVLatent.audio_latent (#145), with NO full-video IC-LoRA guide pinning the frames. Fabio pointed out it already does this from an image. LTXVReferenceAudio + Input_Use_Reference_Audio (#274/#296) are wired and MPI-4 records them as NEVER TESTED. That is the thread to pull for both the singing case and the multi-voice case

The lipdub LoRA is published against ltx-2.3-22b-dev, which is NOT on this machine, and we run int8_convrot distilled-1.1. This was suspected as the cause of the dead runs and is NOT - the framing was. Do not order a 40GB download on that theory
